text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the JBC Classic, and
Smart Falcon
and I are handing out
flyers for the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just one more person, she
wants to
share the joy of dirt racing with
as many as
possible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While we always used to have flyers
leftover, we
pass them all out this time,
and a huge crowd
shows up at the
racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Feeling the heightened enthusiasm and
not
wanting the fervor to die down,
Smart Falcon is
determined to give a
good performance, both on
the track
and in the winning concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
